decision_summary: Approve QIF v0.6.22 cache metadata for discovery surfaces.
rationale: Visionary: cache metadata aligns QIF discovery with stateless agent clients. Builder: implementation is additive on existing JSON outputs and avoids a cache server or new package type. Guardian: cache fields are explicitly freshness hints only and do not authorize actions or claim semantic quality truth.
recommendation: Release v0.6.22 after final residue scan, AOF verification, commit, tag, and GitHub Release.
